slots.label: Label above heading 1
slots.default: Good to know

slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Frequently asked questions

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: What is IT support, and why do I need it?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: IT support covers the services that maintain, troubleshoot and improve your IT systems. From fixing hardware issues and managing software updates to cyber security, it keeps your business operating smoothly and prevents costly downtime.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: Why should I work with WhizzIT?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We offer trusted, award-winning IT support Stevenage services, backed by independent quality audits. Whether you want a fully managed service or extra help alongside your internal team, we tailor our support to you.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: What type of IT support do I need?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: It depends on your setup, your resources, your working hours and whether you’d prefer remote assistance, onsite visits or a combination of both. We’ll help you work out the right mix during a free consultation.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: Do you work with smaller teams?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Yes. We shape the service around your team size, so you get the same tooling, security and response times whatever your headcount.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: Can you provide IT support across the UK?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: Yes. We provide IT support across the UK, both remotely and onsite depending on your location, from our bases in Stevenage and London.

slots.label: Question 6
slots.default: How quickly can I get help when I have an IT issue?

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: We use a priority-based system. P1 faults require immediate attention and are reserved for major incidents where your whole business is unable to operate. Priorities range from P1 down to P5, each with its own SLA that dictates how quickly we respond to and resolve the fault.

slots.label: Question 7
slots.default: How do you onboard new clients?

slots.label: Paragraph 8
slots.default: Our onboarding process is simple. We start with a thorough assessment of your current IT systems and business needs, create a customised support plan, install any tooling needed for remote assistance, and begin supporting your business.

slots.label: Question 8
slots.default: What makes you different from other managed service providers?

slots.label: Paragraph 9
slots.default: We’re a small, family-run managed service provider that prioritises exceptional, personalised service. Unlike larger providers with thousands of clients, we build strong relationships and provide IT support with care, attention and a tailored approach.
